_doc: EXTRACTION-POOL pre-configured cloud providers (MULTI-PROVIDER-AUTH-V1).
A provider JOINS the pool automatically when its api_key_env resolves
(process env first, then the repo .env) AND enabled is not false.
Setup for a new provider = paste its key into .env — nothing else.
NO SECRETS IN THIS FILE — api_key_env names the variable, never the value.
url omits /v1 (the client appends /v1/chat/completions).
reasoning_effort null = omit the field (strict APIs 400 on unsupported
params). structured = capability level: schema|json|text (strongest
the provider supports; 'schema' dispatches as 'json' until a strict-
schema canary passes). Local validation always runs regardless.
The settings primary (Ollama daemon) is NOT listed here; it is always
in the roster. Models re-pinnable at will — a change shows up in the
extraction contract via pool_fingerprint().
stage_pins DEDICATES a stage to one provider (owner 2026-08-30:
parent_enrichment -> nvidia). A pinned stage NEVER silently reroutes:
if the pinned provider is parked/unavailable its jobs fail loudly
with PINNED_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE (enrichment is backfillable by
design). Unpinned stages shard across the pool as normal.

groq1..groq5 = five UNLINKED owner accounts (own rate each), the baseline extraction fleet on qwen/qwen3.8-27b, strict schema (level-1, live-verified). nvidia/nvidia2 dedicated:true = enrichment only, excluded from extraction sharding.

CROSS-PROVIDER-V1 (owner 2026-08-30): one lane swapped each way — extraction shards over groq1-4 + nvidia2 + primary; enrichment pin group = [nvidia, groq5]. A whole-provider outage never stalls either stage, and dispatch failover walks the ring.

gemini1..gemini6 = Google AI Studio keys on gemini-3.1-flash-lite (owner 2026-09-01 re-pin — cheaper than 3.5-flash-lite, strict-schema canary green; the 2.5-flash-lite the owner linked is retired for new users — 3.5-flash-lite is the current cheapest lite tier, strict-schema canary GREEN via the OpenAI-compat endpoint; the compat layer tolerates the client's /v1 suffix so url ends at /v1beta/openai). gemini1-4 shard extraction; gemini5-6 are dedicated enrichment lanes added to the parent_enrichment pin group.

request_char_budget (THROUGHPUT-V2): per-lane payload budget in chars; batch packing respects it so provider 413s cannot happen (groq 18000 measured from the 2026-09-01 413 storm; gemini's 1M-token context takes 120000; nvidia 60000).

GEMINI-VARIANT-LANES (owner 2026-09-01 'ensure all gemini keys call the available gemini models'): Google quotas are PER MODEL per key, so gemini{n}b runs gemini-3.5-flash-lite on the SAME key as gemini{n} (3.1-flash-lite) with an independent quota — 12 gemini lanes from 6 keys. 2.5-lite family retired upstream; non-lite flashes failed the strict-schema canary (parked pending a json-mode canary). groq: request budget 7000 chars + limiter TPM 8000 = the PROVIDER-DECLARED truth (header probe 2026-09-01); groq5 REMOVED from the enrichment pin (8K TPM = ~4 enrichment calls/min = pure failover churn).

GROQ PARKED from the extraction ring (owner speed directive 2026-09-01): 8K TPM declared = a dead-weight slice under rank slicing (one unlucky doc per pass drew an all-groq slice). dedicated:true with no pin = reserved; re-enters by flipping the flag if the tier ever changes.
PROVIDER-REMOVALS-0902: owner removed the groq host (groq1-5, qwen3.8-27b) and the gemma-3-4b candidate on 2026-09-02; keys dropped from .env; limiter blocks removed.

OPENROUTER-LANE-3 (owner 2026-09-02 'which ones work well and should be wired'): qwen/qwen3.7-flash on the owner's SECOND OpenRouter key, reasoning_effort none is MANDATORY (a reasoning model: with thinking on it spends the whole output budget on reasoning tokens and returns nothing). Canary PASS 70 s (8/8 extraction 5.3 s mean, 103-130 tok/s; enrichment 8/8 gist 1.00); structured 'json' (strict schema not canaried). In the extraction ring AND the parent_enrichment pin.

OPENROUTER-ENRICHMENT-LANES-V1 (owner 2026-09-02 'both will be for enrichment lane since enrichment is slow'): openrouter5 = mistral-small-24b-instruct-2501 on the owner's THIRD OpenRouter key, dedicated:true (enrichment pin only, never extraction sharding), json; canary PASS on that key (8/8 + 8/8, 121 s). openrouter4 (ministral-3b-2512) is reserved for the same key IF its canary passes enrichment (first run 4/8).
